verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a documented integrations section (docs.sprinto.com/integrations/overview) with setup guides for ticketing (Jira, ClickUp), identity/device management (JumpCloud) and an HR/finance tool (FreeAgent) used to map offboarding. The quickstart also claims it integrates with your existing cloud stack. The evidence covers only some of the stack categories named in the story, and nothing addresses scopes. Missing for 10: cloud-provider integration docs (e.g. AWS/GCP/Azure), code-hosting integrations (GitHub/GitLab), dedicated MDM integration evidence, any documentation of read-only permission scopes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
